title: Pontoon Pub Crawl, 5 Lakeside Pubs and Restaurants Visit by Boat
includes: Cooler and Ice available upon request
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers have at least maximum of 1600lbs per group or 8 travelers per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our signature Pontoon Pub Crawl experience visiting 4-5 of Winter Haven, FL's best waterfront bars and restaurants. Perfect for groups looking for a fun day on the water.

This is a great way to have a fun night out in our Bars and restaurants on our Chain of Lakes without having to worry about a sober driver. Ideal if your staying in one of our many Vacation homes on the water or Hotels. Otherwise please be responsible and have a sober driver to get you home or we can help you book an Uber or Lyft. 

Our max weight capacity is 1600 lbs per boat (typically 8-10 people). If you have more than 8 in your party or are over the weight capacity please call and we will customize your tour. If you would like a private party please call and we can offer this to you.
